subject: Eval kickoff: Acme Corp trial plan & success criteria
messages:
From: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@acme.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery notes / next steps

Connor — thanks again for the call today. Really helpful to understand Redwood's serving model and the options for private vs dedicated deployments. Alex and I talked through next steps and we'd like to get an evaluation kickoff scheduled so we can validate throughput and quality against our prompt sets.

Proposed kickoff goals:
- Confirm trial plan and timeline (2-week proof-of-concept)
- Align on success criteria (latency targets, quality benchmarks, cost targets)
- Share our prompt set/evals and access model
- Identify technical owners and data/security requirements

Would you and the SE team be available next week for a 60-min kickoff? Our initial availability: Tue 3/2 9:00–11:00 PT or Wed 3/3 9:30–11:30 PT. If one of those works we can lock it in and I’ll add Alex.

I attached a short spreadsheet with our evaluation requirements. Also, quick question — for the eval, will we be able to test both hosted API and a private deployment, or should we scope to hosted first?

Thanks,
Samantha
Head of AI Product
Acme Corp
[Attachment: Acme_evaluation_requirements.xlsx (1 sheet)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T17:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery notes / next steps

Hi Samantha — great to meet you and Alex today, and thanks for the clear ask. Marissa (CS) and Neha (Solutions Engineer) are looped here and will join the kickoff.

We can absolutely run a two-week POC. For scoping, most customers start with hosted API so we can iterate on prompt sets quickly; if you need private deployment for data controls we can scope a parallel technical track but likely won't be necessary for the initial quality/latency eval. We can cover options in the kickoff.

I’m available both of the proposed windows; I can do Wed 3/3 at 10:00 AM PT if that works for Alex. Proposed 60-min kickoff agenda:
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) Trial timeline and approach (10m)
3) Prompt set / evaluation plan (15m)
4) Access, infra needs, and security considerations (15m)
5) Next steps & owners (10m)

I’ve attached our standard evaluation plan so you can review before the meeting. Please confirm preferred time and any extra attendees. If you want a technical deep dive/demo afterwards we can schedule a separate follow-up.

Next steps once we confirm time:
- Share the eval plan doc + Redwood access instructions
- Marissa will send calendar invite and add a HubSpot deal record
- Neha will prepare a short technical checklist (requirements/keys/network)

Attachments:
- redwood-eval-plan.pdf (2 pages)

Best,
Connor O'Brien

connor.obrien@redwood.com

Two quick asks to add to the agenda:
- We have a short list of compliance questions (data-at-rest and audit logs) — can Marissa or Neha bring the SOC2 evidence checklist?
- Can you confirm what sample tokens/requests you’ll need from us for the prompt set? We can prep a 1000-prompt sample and some prioritized user journeys.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Quick notes/links in advance:
- Agenda: introductions, success criteria, trial plan, prompt-set requirements, access/keys, security items, next steps
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2026-42

Neha — I’ll send you Alex's high-level latency/throughput targets after this and the prompt-set sample once Samantha uploads it to the shared doc.

Samantha & Alex — if you’d like a short pre-kickoff demo (15m) to see Redwood's console and streaming response behavior we can do that right before the kickoff — say 9:40–9:55 PT. Let me know.
